request: A 15 to 25 second motion promo about LitHermes for its GitHub README: what a person types, what appears and what they get.
pathReason: The film draws a terminal, a check track, a handoff page and one ember that travels between them; the subject is a working session, and type alone would only name it.
idea: One word typed in a dark terminal lights a single ember that walks the work through plan, make and check, is left on a page, and is picked up by the next session.
audience: Developers and researchers who already run Hermes Agent and are deciding whether to install a plugin for it.
channel: The LitHermes GitHub README, autoplaying as a silent looping preview with the MP4 one click away.
formatReason: A README embeds a landscape preview at full column width; the same frames read on a phone at 390 px because the type is set very large.

beats.purpose: Opening motif: a single lime cursor, then one word.
beats.onScreen: A near-black frame with a warm ember glow low on the left. A lime block cursor sits alone, then the giant word lit types itself in ivory Pretendard beside it, and a quiet line under it says Add one word.
beats.motion: Letters rise through masks one by one while the cursor steps along; the subline rises through its own mask; then the whole word scales down and travels toward a terminal prompt.
beats.sound: A soft pad from the first frame and a slow rise into the next scene.

beats.purpose: Set piece: the request and the reply that says the work has started.
beats.onScreen: The giant word has landed as the first word of a prompt inside a dark terminal pane. The rest of the request types out, and the reply opens with the small five-row LIT mark and the line LIT IGNITED with the flame. The headline It starts the work sits above the pane.
beats.motion: A scale hand-off: the display word cross-fades into the monospace prompt word as it lands; the mark rows wipe in from the left and the label types in gradient; the headline rises through a mask.
beats.sound: A hit as the word lands on the cut; the pulse steps in under the typing.

beats.purpose: Set piece: the loop of plan, make, check, ending in a real check.
beats.onScreen: The terminal falls away. The words Plan, Make and Check stand very large across a hairline track. One orange ember arrives from the reply and walks the track, lighting each word and node in turn, and a lime ring and tick draw themselves at Check.
beats.motion: The ember travels an arc from the flame in the reply to the first node, then eases along the track; words rise through masks and brighten as it reaches them; the ring and tick stroke in.
beats.sound: A hit on the cut as the ember lands; the pulse thins so each node reads.

beats.purpose: Peak: the work leaves a note behind.
beats.onScreen: The words slide away and the ember arcs to a paper page named HANDOFF.md that rises on the right, with a result block and a next step block whose bar is lime. On the left the headline Leave the next step, and a slim terminal types the handoff command and then says stay lit.
beats.motion: Words exit upward through masks; the ember flies to the page corner and dissolves into it; the page wipes up from its bottom edge and its lines write in from the left; the headline rises through a mask.
beats.sound: A hit on the cut; a rise into the next session.

beats.purpose: Payoff: a new session picks the note up.
beats.onScreen: A fresh terminal opens on the left with the LitHermes mark in the Ignition colours, the name and LIT ready, and a prompt that types read the handoff and continue. The page has docked to the right at a smaller size and a lime line draws from it to the prompt. The headline says The next session continues.
beats.motion: The pane opens from its centre; the page glides and scales into its dock while rotating level; a lime path draws from the page to the prompt.
beats.sound: A hit as the new pane opens, then a rise toward the last line.

beats.purpose: Resolve: everything settles into one line.
beats.onScreen: The terminal, page and headline fall away. On a clean near-black frame the line Keep the work lit stands large with lit in lime, a hairline draws under it, and the name LitHermes sits quietly below.
beats.motion: Panes fade and settle back; the line rises through masks word by word; the hairline draws outward from the centre; the name rises last.
beats.sound: A cadence: a struck chord under the closing line, ringing to the end.

subject.name: LitHermes
specifics: Adding the word lit to a request in Hermes Agent starts the work, and the reply opens with a LIT IGNITED line and the small LIT mark.
A task runs plan, make, check, and can end with a HANDOFF.md that the next session reads to continue.
The Ignition skin greets a new session with the LIT mark and LIT ready, and says stay lit on exit.

typePlan.hierarchy: Pretendard 700 at 92 to 560 px for the display word, headlines and closing line, Pretendard 400 for the quiet lines, MesloLGS NF at 44 px for everything a terminal prints. Hierarchy comes from size, color, position and motion only. Archivo stays out because the new look is carried by one family.

palette.role: near-black ground taken from the cover
lime: cursor, active nodes, the next step
ember: the flame and the travelling spark
dim words waiting to be lit

sound.plan: A warm generated bed: felt strings and a brushed pulse at 84 BPM in E minor with hits on the cuts, rises into the cuts, and a struck tonic chord under the closing line.

lines: lit fix the failing login test

inventions: The example request lit fix the failing login test and the sample line read the handoff and continue.
The order of beats and the wording of every headline and quiet line; the product strings LIT IGNITED, LIT ready, stay lit, HANDOFF.md and the four colours are the product's own.
The page rows result and next step as a picture of what a handoff holds.
ambition: A restrained type film rather than a screen recording: one giant word that becomes a prompt by a scale hand-off, one ember that carries the eye through the loop, large Pretendard headlines with wide margins, masks and path draws for every transition, and a first frame that is only a lime cursor on near-black.
